edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against tx.origin and used as the mint recipient in mintAstroGator.
tx.origin is read for the require(msg.sender == tx.origin) authorization check, an origin-based access control pattern.
msg.sender is used as the recipient of _safeMint inside reserveAstroGators.
remaining is used as the modulus for blockhash and decremented by one without SafeMath.
cache mapping is read and written during the drawIndex swap-and-pop computation.
drawIndex is invoked inside the mintAstroGator mint loop.
drawIndex is invoked inside the reserveAstroGators mint loop.
drawIndex performs unchecked modulo and subtraction on remaining.
_safeMint in mintAstroGator triggers the onERC721Received callback on the recipient contract.
msg.sender-controlled recipient receives the external onERC721Received callback during minting.
withdraw forwards the full balance through an unchecked low-level call{value} that can reenter.
treasury is the target address receiving the funds in the low-level call.
treasury state variable is read inside withdraw as the payment destination.
maxAstroGatorPurchase bounds numberOfTokens in mintAstroGator.
AstroGatorPrice.mul(numberOfTokens) computes the required payment in mintAstroGator.

MAX_AstroGators caps totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) in reserveAstroGators.
saleIsActive must be true for mintAstroGator to proceed.
flipSaleState reads saleIsActive before negating it.
baseURI parameter is written to state via _setBaseURI in setBaseURI.
numberOfTokens is added to totalSupply() in the reserveAstroGators supply check.
numberOfTokens drives the price multiplication, the per-tx cap check and the mint loop.

mintIndex is passed to _safeMint, which performs the external callback.
balance is the value forwarded by the low-level call in withdraw.

mintIndex feeds the _safeMint call in reserveAstroGators.
